d.ko: Swing through the trees, spin sticky webs, and make friends with bugs! Be the adorable spider you've always wanted to be.
d.en: Swing through the trees, spin sticky webs, and make friends with bugs! Be the adorable spider you've always wanted to be.
d.zh: 在树枝间摇荡，织出黏黏的网，跟小虫子们交朋友！去当那只你一直想当的可爱小蜘蛛吧。
